svg.title: DISASTER RECOVERY AND MULTI-REGION: sketchnote
svg.text: Plan for losing a region, or your data, before it happens.
RPO: how much data you can lose. RTO: how long you can be
cost and complexity grow to the right; downtime and data loss shrink
Backup & restore → pilot light → warm standby → active-active:
each rung costs more and recovers faster.
Test restores: the measured time is your real
Async cross-region replication: RPO not quite
Plan the failback; run game days
"The ledger has RPO near zero and RTO of 15
minutes: sync replicas across zones, a warm
standby region, and point-in-time backups in a
separate account. Browsing and search run
